source.prompt: A single playing-card back design rendered as a clean game sprite for a casual UNO-style card game. The card is a portrait-oriented rectangle with smoothly rounded corners, shown perfectly flat and front-facing, centered in the frame. The entire back is a rich royal purple in the hue #7c3aed, framed by an ornate symmetrical border of lighter lavender and deep violet filigree that runs around all four edges. In the exact center sits a decorative emblem: two interlocking ribbon-like crescent shapes woven into a balanced, mirror-symmetric monogram-style motif, rendered in pale lavender and gold #fbbf24 highlights. This emblem is purely abstract ornamentation and must not form any real letters or words; the actual game monogram will be overlaid programmatically later. The surface has a subtle linen texture and a soft glossy sheen, with a gentle diagonal highlight suggesting a premium laminated card stock. Lighting is a soft even studio key light from the upper left with a faint cool rim on the right edge, giving the card a clean product-shot look. Materials read as smooth laminated card stock, fine embossed filigree, and a subtle woven linen grain. The camera is a straight-on orthographic front view with no perspective tilt, framing the whole card with even margins. The art style is a refined stylized 3D cartoon render with hand-painted textures, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold rounded shapes, and a glossy casual-game finish, using a cohesive palette of purple #7c3aed, lavender, and gold #fbbf24. centered, isolated single object on a plain neutral light-gray studio background, no horizon, no shadow catcher plane, no text, no watermark
